:::{#def-orthonormal-vectors}
#### Orthonormal vectors

A set of vectors $\{\vx_1, \vx_2, \ldots, \vx_k\}$ is **orthonormal** if
the vectors are mutually orthogonal (@def-orthogonal-vectors)
and each has norm $1$ (@def-euclidean-norm), that is, [unit length](#def-unit-vector):

$$\vx_i \cdot \vx_j =
\begin{cases}
1 & \text{if } i = j \\
0 & \text{if } i \neq j
\end{cases}$$

:::
